build_linear_crf_model: build a linear-chain CRF model with potentials and transitions graphs using gtn
create_transition_graph: create a bigram transition graph for a given number of output classes
create_potential_graph: create a unary potential graph for given features and output classes
sample_crf_data: sample training data from a CRF model using viterbi path decoding
compute_crf_loss: compute the CRF negative log-likelihood loss for a sequence pair
